items.title: Clean subtitles
items.text: Quotes, brackets and music notes are gone; only the marks that matter stay. Works with every subtitle, AI-translated ones too.

items.title: Your addons' subtitles first
items.text: Chosen by themselves from your addons, OpenSubtitles when none has them, and kept in sync quietly in the background.

items.title: More skips
items.text: Skip intro, recap and credits on far more films, series and anime, from more sources.

items.title: Search you can trust
items.text: Results are titles on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and the like. Settings › Playback.
